page.overview:
What is Time-stream?

The "time-stream" is a term used to describe the concept that time is a constant forward flow, and that flow can be perceived. Several beings in the galaxy, such as the Seers of the H'drachi, reported the ability to view the time-stream using the Force. They claim they were therefore able to avoid or change the future they had seen, creating divergences in the time-stream.
